# Unsupported routes and methods return Protocol errors

<!-- Generated by tests/e2e. Regenerate with ATLAS_E2E_UPDATE=1; review every change. -->

## 1. An unknown route is not found

direct `GET /missing` with <operator key>

→ **404**
```json
{
  "code": "not_found",
  "message": "This route is not available."
}
```

## 2. An unsupported method on a known route is not allowed

direct `POST /health` with <operator key>

→ **405**
```json
{
  "code": "method_not_allowed",
  "message": "This route does not support the method."
}
```
